name: base_reg_s
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm

jobs.name: base_reg_s
jobs.cmd: python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_reg_S.json --only base_gpu_smoke_levers --device cuda; SKIP=; [ -f babylm/runs/base_gpu_smoke_levers/result.json ] || { echo '[reg] smoke failed: skipping ema/mntp cells'; SKIP='ema|mntp'; }; for n in base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_ep2 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_ep4 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_hwd0p03 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_hwd0p1 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_hwd0p3 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_ewd0p001 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_ema0p99 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_ema0p998 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_mntp0p25 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_mntp0p5 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_do0p1 base_S_wd2p0_lr0p5_do0p2; do if [ -n "$SKIP" ] && echo $n | grep -qE "$SKIP"; then echo "[reg] skip $n"; continue; fi; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_reg_S.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[run] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[run] score $n failed"; }; done
